en.title: The Vedic metres
en.body:
There are seven principal metres, but by the count of syllables fourteen main metres can be reckoned:
Gāyatrī – 24
Uṣṇik – 28
Anuṣṭubh – 32
Bṛhatī – 36
Paṅkti – 40
Triṣṭubh – 44
Jagatī – 48
Atijagatī – 52
Śakvarī – 56
Atiśakvarī – 60
Aṣṭi – 64
Atyaṣṭi – 68
Dhṛti – 72
Atidhṛti – 76
